translation: Sweet-sour in flavor, neutral to warm, non-toxic. It treats chills and fever, heat-in-the-center (熱中), wasting-thirst (消渴), stopping diarrhea (止泄), benefiting urination (利小便), vomiting-with-rebellion (吐逆), sudden [blank], and fullness (滿). Also, the leaf is named huo (藿), and treats frequent urination (小便數) and removes vexing heat (去煩熱).
